description: Perpetual futures funding rates for up to 8 symbols across Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, OKX, Binance and Bybit in one call: rate per interval, % per 8h, APR (positive = longs pay shorts), next funding time, mark price, open interest; the cross-venue spread (carry) per symbol; and the most positive / most negative funding across every Hyperliquid perp. PAID: $0.002 per call (x402 over MCP, USDC on Base), or free with a pass from funding_feed_pass (24h $0.250, 7 days $1.000). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; if no venue answers nothing is charged. Same data as GET /v1/funding-rates.

pass.description: Optional pass token (ffp1....) from funding_feed_pass. You can also send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" on the MCP HTTP request. With a valid pass this call is free.

symbols.description: Comma list of base tickers, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL (default BTC,ETH,SOL; max 8)

top.description: How many most-positive / most-negative Hyperliquid perps to list (default 10)

venues.description: Comma list of venues or all (default): hyperliquid, dydx, okx, binance, bybit

name: funding_rates
title: Perp funding rates on 5 venues ($0.002, or free with a pass)
